research_role: one deeper lifecycle experiment after uniform h40 and fixed early exits failed

economic_hypothesis.observation: the frozen Champion accrues positively through d20, while blanket h40 diluted capital and failed
economic_hypothesis.question: does retaining only positions already profitable at the causal h20 decision allow persistent winners to compound without keeping the full losing cohort?
economic_hypothesis.novelty: conditional winner retention is distinct from the closed uniform h40 lifecycle and all closed fixed d3/d5/d10/d15 exit rules

frozen_strategy.selection: unchanged Weekly Industry Diffusion plus within-industry prior-20-session Low-MAX, exact Top 10
frozen_strategy.base_due: entry market-session index plus 20, at the due open
frozen_strategy.extension_decision: at the base due open, use only the immediately preceding market session close and cash actions already visible; extend iff hypothetical net liquidation proceeds at that close are strictly greater than invested cost
frozen_strategy.extended_due: entry market-session index plus 40, at the due open
frozen_strategy.capital: unchanged one-quarter pre-entry-NAV cohort target, capped by available cash; no sale or borrowing to fund a new cohort
frozen_strategy.weights: equal across executable names in each new cohort
frozen_strategy.execution: unchanged T+1, price limits, suspensions, QD-010 pre-effective exits, cash actions, and 20 bps per side

prohibited: profit threshold grid or neighboring extension horizon
loss extension, trailing stop, take-profit, re-entry, or market-state rescue
changed selection, ranking, Top-N, schedule, or cohort weights
same-open extension decision using that open or later information
